import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    0: {"processing_time": 96, "due_date": 164, "weight": 10},
    1: {"processing_time": 72, "due_date": 503, "weight": 6},
    2: {"processing_time": 26, "due_date": 335, "weight": 8},
    3: {"processing_time": 53, "due_date": 162, "weight": 10},
    4: {"processing_time": 49, "due_date": 172, "weight": 5},
    5: {"processing_time": 58, "due_date": 769, "weight": 10},
    6: {"processing_time": 22, "due_date": 735, "weight": 6},
    7: {"processing_time": 56, "due_date": 661, "weight": 9},
    8: {"processing_time": 52, "due_date": 479, "weight": 10},
    9: {"processing_time": 9, "due_date": 382, "weight": 2},
    10: {"processing_time": 40, "due_date": 739, "weight": 7},
    11: {"processing_time": 80, "due_date": 337, "weight": 1},
    12: {"processing_time": 90, "due_date": 643, "weight": 6},
    13: {"processing_time": 71, "due_date": 418, "weight": 5},
    14: {"processing_time": 10, "due_date": 629, "weight": 8},
    15: {"processing_time": 30, "due_date": 538, "weight": 2},
    16: {"processing_time": 6, "due_date": 167, "weight": 4},
    17: {"processing_time": 34, "due_date": 456, "weight": 7},
    18: {"processing_time": 21, "due_date": 637, "weight": 6},
    19: {"processing_time": 58, "due_date": 117, "weight": 2},
    20: {"processing_time": 56, "due_date": 565, "weight": 2},
    21: {"processing_time": 87, "due_date": 617, "weight": 1},
    22: {"processing_time": 16, "due_date": 316, "weight": 9},
    23: {"processing_time": 46, "due_date": 331, "weight": 5},
    24: {"processing_time": 22, "due_date": 595, "weight": 4},
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Number of jobs
n = len(jobs)

# Variables
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")   # Sequencing variables

# Objective: Minimize the total weighted tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Completion time constraints
for j in range(n):
    model.addConstr(C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n) if i != j))

# Tardiness constraints
for j in range(n):
    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"])

# Sequencing constraints
for i in range(n):
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n) if i != j) == 1)
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n) if i != j) == 1)

# Solve the model
model.optimize()

# Extract the job sequence
sequence = sorted(range(n), key=lambda j: C[j].X)

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
import json
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
